solution:
"""
URL: https://leetcode.com/problems/occurrences-after-bigram/description/?envType=problem-list-v2&envId=vn57k9wr

1078. Occurrences After Bigram

Given two strings first and second, consider occurrences in some text of the form "first second third", where second comes immediately after first, and third comes immediately after second.

Return an array of all the words third for each occurrence of "first second third".


Example 1:

Input: text = "alice is a good girl she is a good student", first = "a", second = "good"
Output: ["girl","student"]

Example 2:

Input: text = "we will we will rock you", first = "we", second = "will"
Output: ["we","rock"]


Constraints:

    1 <= text.length <= 1000
    text consists of lowercase English letters and spaces.
    All the words in text are separated by a single space.
    1 <= first.length, second.length <= 10
    first and second consist of lowercase English letters.
    text will not have any leading or trailing spaces.
"""


class Solution:
    def findOcurrences(self, text: str, first: str, second: str) -> List[str]:
        words = text.split()
        result = []
        for i in range(len(words) - 2):
            if words[i] == first and words[i + 1] == second:
                result.append(words[i + 2])
        return result


sol = Solution()

print(
    sol.findOcurrences("alice is a good girl she is a good student", "a", "good")
)  # ["girl","student"]

assert sol.findOcurrences(
    "alice is a good girl she is a good student", "a", "good"
) == ["girl", "student"]
assert sol.findOcurrences("we will we will rock you", "we", "will") == ["we", "rock"]

assert sol.findOcurrences("", "a", "b") == []
assert sol.findOcurrences("a b c", "a", "b") == ["c"]
assert sol.findOcurrences("a a a a a", "a", "a") == ["a", "a", "a"]
assert sol.findOcurrences(
    "a b c d e f g h i j k l m n o p q r s t u v w x y z", "x", "y"
) == ["z"]
assert sol.findOcurrences(
    "one two three four five six seven eight nine ten", "five", "six"
) == ["seven"]
assert sol.findOcurrences(
    "repeat repeat repeat repeat repeat repeat", "repeat", "repeat"
) == ["repeat", "repeat", "repeat", "repeat"]
assert sol.findOcurrences(
    "negative numbers are not handled here", "numbers", "are"
) == ["not"]
assert sol.findOcurrences(
    "a b c a b c a b c a b c a b c a b c a b c a b c a b c", "a", "b"
) == ["c", "c", "c", "c", "c", "c", "c", "c", "c"]
assert sol.findOcurrences(
    "first second third first second third first second third", "first", "second"
) == ["third", "third", "third"]
assert sol.findOcurrences(
    "a b a b a b a b a b a b a b a b a b a b a b a b a b", "a", "b"
) == ["a", "a", "a", "a", "a", "a", "a", "a", "a", "a", "a", "a"]
assert sol.findOcurrences(
    "word1 word2 word3 word1 word2 word3 word1 word2 word3", "word1", "word2"
) == ["word3", "word3", "word3"]
assert sol.findOcurrences(
    "a b c d e f g h i j k l m n o p q r s t u v w x y z a b", "y", "z"
) == ["a"]
